source: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: docs re-fetched 2026-10-02 by the M0-T174 D-091 TW4 Linux recertification (curl -sS -L, HTTP 200, 2,919,589 bytes). The delivered hook-event set is IDENTICAL to the 2.1.281 catalog (same 33 names; each of the 33 present as its documented id-anchor section, none missing; no new hook-event anchor found). The three new PascalCase tokens that appear near hook/event context (SubagentHandback, TaskUpdate, AskUserQuestion) are TOOLS, not hook events (SubagentHandback is the subagent hand-back tool added in Claude Code v2.1.271 that a PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook matches ON; TaskUpdate is the tool that triggers TaskCreated/TaskCompleted; AskUserQuestion is a tool heading under the tools/permission section) - verified from their doc context, not guessed. 2.1.287 is a benign bump at the hook-event surface: NO hook-event drift versus 2.1.281 (and so none versus 2.1.252). The doc grew ~19KB vs the M0-T159 fetch (2,900,678 -> 2,919,589 bytes) entirely in tool/permission prose, not in the hook-event enumeration. Per-event and common-input field-level docs were not re-derived field-by-field (same documentation-confidence stance M0-T159/R287 took); only the delivered event NAME set was reconciled. The 2_1_247/2_1_248/2_1_251/2_1_252/2_1_281 catalogs stay committed as append-only history.

common_input_fields.hook_event_name: name of the event that fired (measured-live on 2.1.246/2.1.247 in statusline_live_2026-08-27_2_1_247_r162_discharge.json hook_userpromptsubmit_* payloads)
common_input_fields.transcript_path: path to conversation JSON (masked [HOME] in every committed artifact)
common_input_fields.cwd: working directory when the hook fired
common_input_fields.permission_mode: default | plan | acceptEdits | auto | dontAsk | bypassPermissions
common_input_fields.prompt_id: UUID of the user prompt; absent until first user input; requires >= 2.1.196
common_input_fields.effort: object with level field; present for tool-use context events when the model supports effort
common_input_fields.agent_id: subagent identifier (only when running with --agent or inside a subagent)
common_input_fields.agent_type: agent name (only when running with --agent or inside a subagent)
common_input_fields.field_note: Only the documented common input fields are recorded, carried unchanged from the 2.1.281 catalog. No PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch-specific payload fields are invented here: the M0-T174 fetch reconciled the event NAME set from the re-fetched docs; per-event field-level docs were not re-derived. Per-event measured-live payload capture stays the owner-gated C1 canary (R192/R197).

drift_vs_2_1_220.baseline: telemetry_hooks.KNOWN_HOOK_EVENTS (official docs at 2.1.220, fetched 2026-08-25; identical name-for-name to the 2.1.247 and 2.1.248 catalogs at 31 events)
drift_vs_2_1_220.note: REAL +2 event-set drift first seen at 2.1.251 CARRIED UNCHANGED through 2.1.252 and 2.1.281 to 2.1.287: PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch on the 31-event 2.1.220 baseline (33 total); no events removed; no change 2.1.281->2.1.287. The deterministic drift test asserts this recorded reconciliation matches catalog_drift() output (added=[PostModelSwitch, PreModelSwitch], removed=[], sorted); the live tooth goes RED if the installed version moves past this fixture's claude_version (2.1.287) without a re-capture. KNOWN_HOOK_EVENTS is deliberately NOT widened; the drift is recorded as a reconciled FACT the test bites on, exactly as R173 requires.
